Side and rear views remain distinct from the front; no duplicated frame masquerades as a second camera.
64-point hole contours reduce the coarse 32-point chords; actual quarter-profile rim highlights remain geometric, not a bevel shader.
The wide frames retain the complete body with top/bottom margins.
The short Horizon specimen naturally occupies less frame height; this is deliberate fixed-scale photography, not a missing model.
known_limits: Fine finite polygon sampling and render noise still exist; no continuous surface/per-pixel perfection claim.
Shared-vertex adjacent-face BVH exclusion and numerical geometry thresholds remain in the checker.
A visually plausible ground pose does not establish stability or load capacity.
